children: Iron ore prices are higher in early Asian trading. Prices are likely to stay rangebound at a relatively low level in the near term, according to Baocheng Futures in a research note. High shipment fees are supporting prices, the analysts say. The black metal meanwhile also faces pressure from weak demand and high supply, the analysts note. The most-traded iron-ore contract on the Dalian Commodity Exchange is 0.6% higher at CNY716.0 a ton.(tracy.qu@wsj.com)
